description: Shortlist Italian home internet offers from the published website catalogue. Filter technology, advertised download/upload speeds on the SAME connection, included modem and comparable monthly price. Address availability is NOT checked; speeds are advertised, not guaranteed at your address. Default: price ascending, 10 results, Italian links. Unknown or unconfirmed prices do not match a price cap. Use get_product/compare_products with category home_internet and connection matching these search filters to retain the chosen connection. Prices exclude other charges; conditional quotes require all qualifications.

locale.description: Website link language; source terms may remain Italian.

max_commitment_months.description: 0 = no minimum term (senza vincoli); 12 = at most 12 months. Unknown terms are excluded.

max_monthly_price_eur.description: Maximum displayed comparable monthly equivalent. Qualified quotes retain their conditions; unknown prices do not match.

profile_id.description: Exact published profile_id. Required when connection filters do not identify a single profile for a profile-specific price.

providers.description: Exact provider IDs from results; unknown IDs are rejected.

name: search_home_internet
